name: One Night Fairytale
source:
An annual party is taking place in the palace where you work as a servant. Many renowned people are attending, including some of the protagonists of the famous fairytales! But while your coworker is having the time of her life, you can't be bothered. That is, until an opportunity of a lifetime presents itself before you. Will you turn the direction of your life and find love in this ball?

[From [url=https://monstersandlove.itch.io/one-night-fairytale]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你作为仆人工作的宫殿正在举办一年一度的聚会。许多名人都出席了，其中包括一些著名童话故事的主角！但是当你的同事正在享受她的生活时，你就不用担心了。也就是说，直到一个千载难逢的机会出现在你面前。你会改变你的人生方向并在这个球中找到爱情吗？

[来自[url=https://monstersandlove.itch.io/one-night-fairytale]itch.io[/url]]
